text: Besides those already mentioned, the lords had a house and church at Logan, on the south side of Cochin-dal, a strong condition on rock in the near a Danne walk, at the north-east end of the country, fire they made this island their residence after their explication from that of Man in 1204—There is a tendency that while the site of Man may part of the Kingdom of the Ides, the rents were far a time paid in this country: these in seven were paid on a red, still called Org- _acanton_, or the revel of the silver rust;? the other, _Org-a-amrgel,_ or "the rock of mean in kind." These lie opposite to each other, at the month of a harbour on the south side of this island. There are several force built on the idea in fresh water takes, and divers covered in different parts of the island, which have been used occasionally as places of strength. The island is divided into four parishes, viz. Kildahon, Kildahon, and Kildamore. The products is born of different kinds ; such as bears, which sometimes yields eleven folds and non-sig fold. Much flag is raised here, and about 2000, worth the end out of the island in yarn, which might better be manufactured on the spay, is give employ the poet native. Notwithstanding the experiences of the land, above 1000, worth of meal is annually imported (A). Ale is frequently made in this island the young top of earth, mixing technique due to that plant with one of mal, sometimes adding hops.
